_comment: The demo page's requests live here so a test can call every one of them and prove each button is a real tool with real arguments. {{next-friday}} is filled in at load. Examples with "who" and "source" are real people's words (see evals/real-voices.json); the page shows who said them and links where. The rest are our wording, for jobs nobody we found has asked about in public.

requests.say: There is currently a very high KP index has anyone had any Issues using GPS navigation?
requests.who: A drone builder on the ArduPilot forum, 11 May 2024

requests.say: Aurora on red alert. Is it just tonight?
requests.who: A forum member in Britain, 10 May 2024

requests.say: May 10, 2024: it showed the tractor going in circles and auto steer didn't work, and you couldn't engage it.
requests.who: Dennis Wolff, a South Dakota farmer, on that day

requests.say: My guidance is out. What else is affected?
What can you do?
No GPS. We're right in the middle of corn planting.
requests.who: Kevin Kenney, a Nebraska farmer, 10 May 2024

requests.say: Our dealer says the storm has affected all brands of GPS, not solely John Deere. Should we shut off RTK?
requests.who: A John Deere dealer's message to farmers, May 2024 (the question is ours)

requests.say: Could I spray instead?
I have to be planted by Friday.
I need twelve hours of planting and six of spraying. When do I run them?
Which weeks in the next month and a half are worth booking a crew for?
How many hours did space weather cost the planter this year?
Tell me when planting clears.
I planted 40 acres this morning.
When does it clear?
What can I run at all today?
Is anything clear yet?
Give me the report for the last week.
I am flying a drone show in Hong Kong tonight. Can it run?
Would this have any effect on GPS system and therefore is it recommended to avoid flying during this period?
requests.who: A drone pilot on the Phantom Pilots forum, during a G4 storm

requests.say: I attempted to fly 2 drones last night and both had compass issues
requests.who: A drone pilot on the Mavic Pilots forum, during a G4 watch

requests.say: Can my survey crew work near Ludhiana, India?
I run autonomous haul trucks at a mine.
I run satellites. What should I do?
I run geostationary satellites. Is charging a risk right now?
We have a crew on the way to the Moon. What should we do about the sun?
We are adjusting the flight pattern of a few of our flights. We're flying further south than we would normally fly.
Late this evening our DGNSS differential signal went unstable, and DGNSS 1 and 2 both dropped out of DP control.

args.seeing: Late this evening our DGNSS differential signal went unstable, and DGNSS 1 and 2 both dropped out of DP control.

requests.who: A ship's crew, from an IMCA incident report

requests.say: I run a shortwave radio net.
We're seeing persistent geomagnetically induced current at multiple stations.

args.seeing: We're seeing persistent geomagnetically induced current at multiple stations.

requests.who: PJM, the US grid operator, 10 May 2024

requests.say: I run a GPU cluster. What should I do about this storm?
I noticed one of my commercial GPS-disciplined NTP servers had lost the GPS 1PPS timing signal

args.seeing: I noticed one of my commercial GPS-disciplined NTP servers had lost the GPS 1PPS timing signal

requests.who: A timing engineer on the time-nuts list

requests.say: We run delivery robots in Fargo, North Dakota. Can they trust their GPS right now?
